description: F51 Red Flag Detection Rules — computable rules are evaluated by FraudPatternAnalyst and the f51-hub adapter against DataHub market data; provider-gated rules (insider data, order book, social platforms) remain documented but non-computable until a provider is available.

rules.name: Volume Spike Without News
rules.description: Daily volume > 5x 20-day average with no SEC filing, earnings, or major news within 48 hours.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R001 not computable: news/filing timeline provider not available

rules.name: Social Media Pump Language
rules.description: Ticker mentioned with terms like 'moon', '100x', 'next big thing', 'guaranteed', 'no way this fails' on Reddit/Twitter.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R002 not computable: social platform stream provider not available

rules.name: Insider Selling Near Promotion Peak
rules.description: Insider sales > $100K within 7 days of social media promotion spike or volume anomaly.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R003 not computable: insider transaction feed not available

rules.name: Microcap No Revenue
rules.description: Market cap < $50M AND quarterly revenue < $100K. Shell company risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R004 not computable: quarterly revenue source not available (superseded by no_revenue_with_operations when revenue is present)

rules.name: Price Manipulation Close
rules.description: > 30% of daily volume occurs in last 10 minutes of trading. Closing price manipulation risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R005 not computable: intraday/order-flow data not available

rules.name: Coordinated Promotion
rules.description: Same ticker promoted across 3+ social platforms within 24 hours by accounts with low karma/follower overlap.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R006 not computable: cross-platform promotion data not available

rules.name: Spread Anomaly
rules.description: Bid-ask spread > 5% of price for stock with daily volume > $1M. Liquidity concern or spoofing.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R007 not computable: bid-ask quote data not available

rules.name: Crypto Exchange Risk
rules.description: Asset traded on unregulated exchange without KYC/AML compliance. High fraud risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R008 not computable: exchange compliance registry not available

rules.name: Penny Stock Momentum
rules.description: Stock < $5 with > 100% price increase in 5 days. Momentum trap risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R009 not computable: 5-day price-window enrichment not wired into rule engine

rules.name: Wash Trading Pattern
rules.description: Volume-to-market-cap > 100% with no price movement. Circular trading suspected.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R010 not computable: volume/market-cap ratio rule not wired into rule engine

rules.name: Newsletter Pump
rules.description: Ticker promoted in 'investment newsletter' from unknown source. Paid promotion = pump.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R011 not computable: newsletter promotion source not available

rules.name: Celebrity Endorsement
rules.description: Ticker or crypto promoted by celebrity/influencer without #ad disclosure. Illegal promotion.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R012 not computable: endorsement disclosure stream not available

rules.name: Guaranteed Return Promise
rules.description: Any mention of 'guaranteed returns', 'risk-free', 'can't lose'. These do not exist in markets.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R013 not computable: social language stream not available

rules.name: TSX Venture Risk
rules.description: Ticker on TSX-V with market cap < $10M AND daily volume < $50K. Extreme illiquidity + manipulation risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R014 not computable: exchange/listing registry lookup not wired into rule engine

rules.name: Negative EPS + High Debt
rules.description: Negative earnings AND debt/equity > 3x. Fundamental weakness exploited by manipulators.
rules.limitation_when_absent: R015 not computable: balance-sheet ratios not available from DataHub profile

rules.name: Extreme Volume Spike
rules.description: Volume z-score >= 3.5 versus the 20-day window. Extreme anomaly typically associated with pumps or scheduled-news breaks.
rules.limitation_when_absent: extreme_volume_spike_skipped: volume_z_score not available from DataHub

rules.name: Unusual Volume Without Clear News
rules.description: Volume z-score between 2.0 and 3.5 versus the 20-day window, without an evident catalyst in the data available.
rules.limitation_when_absent: unusual_volume_without_clear_news_skipped: volume_z_score not available from DataHub

rules.name: Price Spike With High Volatility
rules.description: Absolute daily return >= 15% (>= 10% for microcaps under $200M market cap). Momentum-trap risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: price_spike_high_volatility_skipped: daily_return not available from DataHub

rules.name: Microcap Concentration
rules.description: Market cap below $50M. High manipulation susceptibility and liquidity risk.
rules.limitation_when_absent: microcap_concentration_skipped: market_cap not available from DataHub for this ticker

rules.name: Vague Hype Sector Description
rules.description: Company description contains 2+ hype keywords ('moon', '100x', 'guaranteed', etc.) without concrete business substance.
rules.limitation_when_absent: vague_hype_sector_description_skipped: company description not available from DataHub for this ticker

rules.name: No Revenue With Operations
rules.description: Reported revenue is zero while market cap exceeds $10M and the company has an operational description. Shell-company risk.
rules.condition: revenue == 0 AND market_cap > $10M AND description length > 50
rules.limitation_when_absent: no_revenue_with_operations_skipped: totalRevenue not available from DataHub for this ticker
